name: Send breach alert emails with RelayShield and Gmail

parameters.content:
## Send breach alert emails with RelayShield and Gmail

### How it works
Runs daily on a schedule and checks your monitored email against RelayShield's breach database and infostealer malware logs. If either signal fires, it sends a formatted security alert email via Gmail with recommended next steps. Nothing is sent when both checks come back clean.

### Setup steps
- Set `monitoredEmail` in your n8n variables (or replace with a static value on both RelayShield nodes)
- Add your RelayShield API credentials to both RelayShield nodes
- Connect and authorize the Gmail credential
- Adjust the Schedule Trigger's cron expression to change how often it runs

### Customization
Add more RelayShield checks (e.g. SIM swap, domain lookalikes) to broaden coverage, or route the alert to Slack/Notion instead of email.

nodes.name: Schedule Trigger
nodes.notes: Runs daily at 8:00 AM. Change the cron expression to adjust the schedule.

nodes.name: RelayShield - Breach Check
nodes.notes: Checks the monitored email against RelayShield's breach database (HIBP + dark web sources). Set monitoredEmail in your n8n variables or replace with a static value.

nodes.name: RelayShield - Infostealer Check
nodes.notes: Checks whether the email has appeared in infostealer malware logs — indicating a device may have been compromised.

nodes.name: Any Threat Detected?
nodes.notes: Proceeds to send an alert email if breach_count > 0 OR infostealer activity was detected.

parameters.subject: 🚨 RelayShield Security Alert — Action Required
parameters.message:
=

Hi,

RelayShield has detected a security event linked to {{ $vars.monitoredEmail }}.

{% if $('RelayShield - Breach Check').item.json.breach_count > 0 %}

⚠️ Credential Breach Detected

Your email address was found in {{ $('RelayShield - Breach Check').item.json.breach_count }} breach(es).

Recommended actions:

  • Change your passwords for any affected services immediately
  • Enable two-factor authentication wherever possible
  • Check for unfamiliar login activity on your accounts
{% endif %} {% if $('RelayShield - Infostealer Check').item.json.found %}

🔴 Infostealer Activity Detected

Your credentials were found in infostealer malware logs. This indicates a device you use may have been infected with credential-harvesting malware.

Recommended actions:

  • Run a full malware scan on all your devices before changing passwords
  • Revoke active sessions for critical accounts (Google, Microsoft, banking)
  • Do not change passwords on a potentially infected device
{% endif %}

Powered by RelayShield — relayshield.net

nodes.name: Send Alert Email via Gmail
nodes.notes: Sends a formatted security alert to the monitored email address. Requires Gmail OAuth2 credentials configured in n8n.

nodes.name: No Threat — No Action
nodes.notes: No breaches or infostealer activity detected. Workflow completes silently.
